About.Feedback.Text: Something went wrong, or you have an idea? Write to us. The letter already holds the version and the system, and your mail program shows it before anything is sent.
About.License.Text: Golether is free software under the GNU GPL, version 3 or later: you may use, study, share and change it. It comes without any warranty. Components of other authors keep their own licenses.
About.Privacy.Text: No accounts, no ads, no telemetry. The film, the voices, the cameras and the chat go directly between the participants, encrypted; no server of the project sees them.
About.Title: About Golether

Monitor.Settings.MaxConnections.Hint: More are refused until some close.
Monitor.Settings.MaxConnectionsPerMinute: Connections per minute from one address
Protects against a flood. Raise it when many participants share one address.
Monitor.Settings.MaxPendingPerRoom.Hint: How many participants may wait for one host at the same moment.
Monitor.Settings.MaxRooms.Hint: How many hosts may use the server at the same time.
Monitor.Settings.MaxStunPerMinute: STUN requests per minute from one address
Monitor.Settings.MaxStunPerMinute.Hint: Protects against a flood of STUN requests.
Monitor.Settings.Port.Hint: TCP for the meetings and UDP for STUN. The hosts give it together with the external address.
Monitor.Settings.StatusUrls.Hint: Usually http://127.0.0.1:47980: the page is seen on this computer only. With 0.0.0.0 the status page is open to the network, but the journal of events is still served only here. The monitor reads the first address; several are separated by semicolons.

Monitor.Stop.Confirm.Text: While the server is stopped, hosts cannot meet guests from other networks through it. Sessions that already run directly go on, but those that rely on the server may fail to reconnect after a break.
Monitor.Stop.Confirm.Title: Stop the server?
Monitor.Stop.Tip: Stops the service of the server. Hosts lose the server until it is started again.

Settings.Display.AlwaysShowBarsNote: In full screen the top bar and the player bar do not hide, and the video fits between them. Without this setting the bars lie over the video and leave when the pointer has left them.
Settings.Display.ResizableNote: Lets you change the width of the video and participant areas by dragging the border between them, and swap participant tiles by dragging one onto another. A double click on the border restores the original width.
Settings.Sounds.ChatNote: A short clap of a film clapperboard when another participant writes in the chat. Your own messages and reactions make no sound.
